FROM docker.io/eclipse-temurin:8-jdk

ENV SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=0
ENV TZ=UTC

RUN apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq git curl zip unzip > /dev/null 2>&1

WORKDIR /build

# Clone Spring Framework source at v5.3.33 to get the original source files
RUN git clone --depth 1 --branch v5.3.33 --filter=blob:none --sparse \
    https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework.git sf && \
    cd sf && \
    git sparse-checkout set spring-orm/src/main/java/org/springframework/orm/hibernate5

# Apply the Liferay patches:
# Patch 1 (02-LPD-15177): Remove 'final' from logger field in SessionFactoryUtils.java, add generated comment
RUN cd sf/spring-orm/src/main/java/org/springframework/orm/hibernate5 && \
    sed -i 's/static final Log logger/static Log logger/' SessionFactoryUtils.java && \
    printf '\n/* @generated */' >> SessionFactoryUtils.java

# Patch 2 (01-LPS-100343): Remove disconnect() call in SpringSessionSynchronization.java, add generated comment
RUN cd sf/spring-orm/src/main/java/org/springframework/orm/hibernate5 && \
    sed -i '/\/\/ Eagerly disconnect the Session here, to make release mode "on_close" work on JBoss./d' SpringSessionSynchronization.java && \
    sed -i '/getCurrentSession().disconnect();/d' SpringSessionSynchronization.java && \
    printf '\n/* @generated */' >> SpringSessionSynchronization.java

# Download dependency JARs needed for compilation (checksums verified by build)
RUN mkdir -p /deps && \
    curl -f -o /deps/spring-orm-orig.jar https://maven-central.storage-download.googleapis.com/maven2/org/springframework/spring-orm/5.3.33/spring-orm-5.3.33.jar && \
    curl -f -o /deps/spring-core.jar https://maven-central.storage-download.googleapis.com/maven2/org/springframework/spring-core/5.3.33/spring-core-5.3.33.jar && \
    curl -f -o /deps/spring-beans.jar https://maven-central.storage-download.googleapis.com/maven2/org/springframework/spring-beans/5.3.33/spring-beans-5.3.33.jar && \
    curl -f -o /deps/spring-tx.jar https://maven-central.storage-download.googleapis.com/maven2/org/springframework/spring-tx/5.3.33/spring-tx-5.3.33.jar && \
    curl -f -o /deps/spring-jdbc.jar https://maven-central.storage-download.googleapis.com/maven2/org/springframework/spring-jdbc/5.3.33/spring-jdbc-5.3.33.jar && \
    curl -f -o /deps/spring-context.jar https://maven-central.storage-download.googleapis.com/maven2/org/springframework/spring-context/5.3.33/spring-context-5.3.33.jar && \
    curl -f -o /deps/spring-web.jar https://maven-central.storage-download.googleapis.com/maven2/org/springframework/spring-web/5.3.33/spring-web-5.3.33.jar && \
    curl -f -o /deps/commons-logging.jar https://maven-central.storage-download.googleapis.com/maven2/commons-logging/commons-logging/1.2/commons-logging-1.2.jar && \
    curl -f -o /deps/hibernate-core.jar https://maven-central.storage-download.googleapis.com/maven2/org/hibernate/hibernate-core/5.6.7.Final/hibernate-core-5.6.7.Final.jar && \
    curl -f -o /deps/javax-persistence-api.jar https://maven-central.storage-download.googleapis.com/maven2/javax/persistence/javax.persistence-api/2.2/javax.persistence-api-2.2.jar && \
    curl -f -o /deps/jta-api.jar https://maven-central.storage-download.googleapis.com/maven2/javax/transaction/javax.transaction-api/1.3/javax.transaction-api-1.3.jar && \
    curl -f -o /deps/servlet-api.jar https://maven-central.storage-download.googleapis.com/maven2/javax/servlet/javax.servlet-api/4.0.1/javax.servlet-api-4.0.1.jar && \
    curl -f -o /deps/jboss-logging.jar https://maven-central.storage-download.googleapis.com/maven2/org/jboss/logging/jboss-logging/3.4.3.Final/jboss-logging-3.4.3.Final.jar

# Compile the patched classes from source with full debug info
RUN mkdir -p /build/classes && \
    javac -source 1.8 -target 1.8 -g \
    -cp /deps/spring-orm-orig.jar:/deps/spring-core.jar:/deps/spring-beans.jar:/deps/spring-tx.jar:/deps/spring-jdbc.jar:/deps/spring-context.jar:/deps/spring-web.jar:/deps/commons-logging.jar:/deps/hibernate-core.jar:/deps/javax-persistence-api.jar:/deps/jta-api.jar:/deps/servlet-api.jar:/deps/jboss-logging.jar \
    -d /build/classes \
    sf/spring-orm/src/main/java/org/springframework/orm/hibernate5/SessionFactoryUtils.java \
    sf/spring-orm/src/main/java/org/springframework/orm/hibernate5/SpringSessionSynchronization.java

# Build output JAR: copy upstream, replace the patched classes
RUN mkdir -p /output && \
    cp /deps/spring-orm-orig.jar /output/rebuilt.jar && \
    cd /build/classes && \
    jar uf /output/rebuilt.jar org/springframework/orm/hibernate5/SessionFactoryUtils.class \
                               org/springframework/orm/hibernate5/SpringSessionSynchronization.class && \
    mkdir -p /build/target && \
    cp /output/rebuilt.jar /build/target/org.springframework.orm-5.3.33.LIFERAY-PATCHED-1.jar

# Add Liferay pom.properties and pom.xml metadata (with directory entries)
RUN mkdir -p /tmp/pomdir/META-INF/maven/com.liferay/org.springframework.orm && \
    printf 'artifactId=org.springframework.orm\ngroupId=com.liferay\nversion=5.3.33.LIFERAY-PATCHED-1\n' > /tmp/pomdir/META-INF/maven/com.liferay/org.springframework.orm/pom.properties && \
    printf '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n<project xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd" xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"\n    xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">\n  <!-- This module was also published with a richer model, Gradle metadata,  -->\n  <!-- which should be used instead. Do not delete the following line which  -->\n  <!-- is to indicate to Gradle or any Gradle module metadata file consumer  -->\n  <!-- that they should prefer consuming it instead. -->\n  <!-- do_not_remove: published-with-gradle-metadata -->\n  <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>\n  <groupId>com.liferay</groupId>\n  <artifactId>org.springframework.orm</artifactId>\n  <version>5.3.33.LIFERAY-PATCHED-1</version>\n  <licenses>\n    <license>\n      <name>LGPL 2.1</name>\n      <url>http://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/lgpl-2.1.txt</url>\n    </license>\n  </licenses>\n  <developers>\n    <developer>\n      <name>Brian Wing Shun Chan</name>\n      <organization>Liferay, Inc.</organization>\n      <organizationUrl>http://www.liferay.com</organizationUrl>\n    </developer>\n  </developers>\n  <scm>\n    <connection>scm:git:git@github.com:liferay/liferay-portal.git</connection>\n    <developerConnection>scm:git:git@github.com:liferay/liferay-portal.git</developerConnection>\n    <url>http://github.com/liferay/liferay-portal</url>\n  </scm>\n  <dependencies>\n    <dependency>\n      <groupId>org.hibernate</groupId>\n      <artifactId>hibernate-core</artifactId>\n      <version>5.6.7.Final</version>\n      <scope>compile</scope>\n    </dependency>\n    <dependency>\n      <groupId>org.springframework</groupId>\n      <artifactId>spring-orm</artifactId>\n      <version>5.3.33</version>\n      <scope>compile</scope>\n    </dependency>\n  </dependencies>\n</project>\n' > /tmp/pomdir/META-INF/maven/com.liferay/org.springframework.orm/pom.xml && \
    cd /tmp/pomdir && \
    jar uf /output/rebuilt.jar META-INF/maven/ META-INF/maven/com.liferay/ META-INF/maven/com.liferay/org.springframework.orm/ META-INF/maven/com.liferay/org.springframework.orm/pom.properties META-INF/maven/com.liferay/org.springframework.orm/pom.xml

WORKDIR /build
